html:
Here is the same image as the one I published 2 days ago. The digital processing (DDP for Digital Development Processing) after stacking is different and the result is clearly more detailed and better balanced in color.

In particular, I followed some of the advice given here by Jerry Lodriguss.

I also used a program called Neat Image, which removes noise from an image. Of course the photo isn't any more in focus ;-)
